visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video starts from the interior of a modern car. A male driver with salt-and-pepper hair, wearing white earbuds and a light blue long-sleeved shirt, is seen from behind. He is sitting in the driver's seat, his right hand interacting with a large integrated touchscreen on the dashboard. Beyond the windshield, a dense line of cars is stalled on a wide highway under bright daylight. In the far distance, a massive plume of thick black smoke billows into the clear sky. (2) The camera zooms in towards the windshield, focusing on the scene outside. A man in a red shirt is seen standing outside his vehicle on the road, looking toward the source of the smoke. Cars are tightly packed in multiple lanes. (3) The perspective shifts as the vehicle begins to move slowly past the incident site. On the left side of the highway, an Italian police car (Polizia) is parked with its blue emergency lights flashing. Several personnel in high-visibility vests and police uniforms are walking on the asphalt. A red fire truck is positioned further ahead on the shoulder. (4) The camera pans to the left to show the wreckage. A small dark-colored car is completely engulfed in intense orange flames and surrounded by swirling grey and white smoke. Three firefighters in full protective gear and helmets are actively spraying the fire with a high-pressure hose. The red fire truck is parked immediately adjacent to the burning vehicle.
